Hard covers are used to create higher quality books. It should be noted that creating a book is 100% reliant on quality of ingredients, as well as bonuses from [[Desk II]] and Jeweler Perk. Hence a compromise could be made between cover and chapter quality, depending on what is available and what perks are obtained.
